title: Rename Window-Scoped Tool System To Utility
description:
Rename the entire window-scoped interactive "tool" object model to "utility" everywhere, so the word "tool" is freed up for a different upcoming concept. Full rename, not a compat shim — types, fields, functions, doc comments, and the ui-kit's generic rendering components.

Rust (framework/core/rs/lib.rs): ToolDefinition -> UtilityDefinition, ToolCategory -> UtilityCategory, ToolRef -> UtilityRef, ToolCategory import re-export from ui_wgpu, WindowKindDefinition.tools -> .utilities, AppDefinition.tools -> .utilities, SetActiveTool action variant -> SetActiveUtility (window_kind_id/tool_id field -> utility_id), related doc comments/tests.

ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs: pub mod tools -> pub mod utilities (or equivalent), ToolCategory enum -> UtilityCategory, ToolNode enum -> UtilityNode (Button/Separator/Collection variants unchanged), any tool_id fields -> utility_id.

framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs (AppBuilder/PluginBundle): .tool()/.tool_simple() builder methods -> .utility()/.utility_simple(), doc comments referencing "Scopes tools to a window kind/mode".

Every plugin crate that registers window tools via .tool(...)/.tool_simple(...)/ToolDefinition/ToolCategory: note, puzzle (2d/3d), lowpoly, cad, remodel, raster, draw, procedural, shooting, s, trinity, forms, imperative, and any others found via grep. Update local helper functions like note_tool/puzzle2d_tool/lowpoly_tool/raster_tool/draw_tool/cad_transform_tool -> the *_utility naming, and their call sites' tool ids/labels stay the same (only the Rust identifiers/types rename).

framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx: activeToolByWindowId -> activeUtilityByWindowId, SET_ACTIVE_TOOL action type/dispatch -> SET_ACTIVE_UTILITY, the "🧰️WindowToolRegistry" region -> "🧰️WindowUtilityRegistry", resolveWindowTools -> resolveWindowUtilities, resolveWindowToolNodes -> resolveWindowUtilityNodes, tagSetActiveToolWindow -> tagSetActiveUtilityWindow, windowToolbarNode stays conceptually the toolbar rendering function but should be renamed consistently (e.g. windowUtilityBarNode) since it composes UtilityNode trees, WINDOW_TOOL_CATEGORIES -> WINDOW_UTILITY_CATEGORIES, injectActiveTool -> injectActiveUtility, SET_ACTIVE_TOOL_ACTION_ID -> SET_ACTIVE_UTILITY_ACTION_ID, all related types/imports from ui_wgpu (ToolNode, ToolCategory) and framework/core (ToolDefinition, ToolRef).

ui/js/react/index.tsx (ui-kit): ToolTree component -> UtilityTree, groupToolNodesByCategory -> groupUtilityNodesByCategory, deriveToolNodes -> deriveUtilityNodes, toolDefinitionToSpec -> utilityDefinitionToSpec, and any other Tool-prefixed exports/types feeding this same window-tool data model. Update .storybook/stories/ui/Toolbar.stories.tsx to match (rename story/component references consistently; keep the file itself since project rules forbid new test/example files, so edit in place — do not create a new stories file).

Also update the WIT/plugin ABI and TS bridge if they reference these Rust type names directly (grep framework/plugin/host and any .wit files), and regenerate any generated TS bindings if there's an existing generate script (do not hand-edit gitignored generated files if a generator exists — run it).

Do NOT rename: the generic "toolbar" CSS class names / data-slot attributes if they are purely presentational DOM hooks unrelated to the Tool type names (use judgement — only rename identifiers that denote this specific tool/utility object model, not every English use of the word "tool"). Do NOT touch unrelated "tool" usages like MCP tools, dev tooling, CLI tools, or generic prose in comments about developer tooling.

This is a mechanical, codebase-wide identifier rename with no behavior change. Must compile/typecheck clean afterward (cargo check --tests across touched crates; ui-react and framework-renderer-react typecheck/vitest). Extend existing test files only; do not create new ones. Add code via existing regions/subregions.
summary:
Finished the tool→utility rename sweep that a prior pass had left incomplete, and dropped the redundant "Window" prefix per Task 2.

## Task 1: Finished the rename sweep
Worked file-by-file (grep -i tool, read every hit in context, rename only what denotes the window-scoped Utility object model) across the whole repo, excluding the frozen `.repo/🎫️/**` snapshots and gitignored generated bindings (`framework/product/os/dev/renderer-modules/**`, `framework/product/os/dev/plugin-modules/**`, `public/plugin-modules/**`).

Confirmed-fixed leftovers called out in the ticket:
- `ui/js/react/index.tsx:4374-4375` stale doc comment (`toolId` → `utilityId`, "tool leaf buttons" → "utility leaf buttons").
- `ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs:1103` doc comment `setActiveTool { toolId }` → `setActiveUtility { utilityId }`, plus the whole `derive_utility_nodes`/`DeriveUtilityNodes` region, its golden-JSON tests, and `partition_window_measures`'s doc/tests/locals (`tool_options` → `utility_options`, `tool_scoped_group` → `utility_scoped_group`, etc).

Real bugs found and fixed along the way (stale wire-format assertions/consumers that would have silently mismatched at runtime, discovered because the earlier pass renamed Rust struct fields but not every consumer):
- `raster/plugin/rs/lib.rs` test asserted `"activeTool":"paintBrush"` against `RasterScene.active_utility` (serializes as `activeUtility`) — fixed by the agent handling that file.
- `ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs` golden-JSON test (`GOLDEN_SCENES_JSON`) had two literal `"activeTool"` keys that no longer matched `RasterScene`/`NoteCanvasScene`'s real `activeUtility` wire key.
- `framework/core/js/index.ts`: `RasterScene.activeTool`, `Puzzle2dBoardScene.activeTool`, `NoteCanvasScene.activeTool` TS mirror types were stale (Rust already had `active_utility`/`activeUtility`); fixed the types and every consumer: `raster-host.tsx`, `puzzle-2d-board-host.tsx`, `canvas-2d-host.tsx` (`CanvasLayerRecord.tool`→`.utility`, matching a `"meta:tool"`/`"tool"` JSON record in `draw/plugin/rs/lib.rs` also renamed to `"meta:utility"`/`"utility"`), `note-canvas-host.tsx` (`NoteDocument.activeTool` + every local), `world-3d-host.tsx` (`WorldInteractionRecord.activeTool`, matching `infinite/world/rs/lib.rs`'s `WorldInteractionRecord.active_tool`/`World3dState.active_tool` field, now `active_utility`).
- WASM binding rename to match: `raster/rs/lib.rs` (`RasterHost.active_tool`→`active_utility`, `set_active_tool`→`set_active_utility`, `#[wasm_bindgen(js_name = setActiveTool)]`→`setActiveUtility`), `puzzle/2d/rs/lib.rs` (`set_active_tool_wasm`→`set_active_utility_wasm`, `js_name`, `BoardHost.set_active_tool` call sites), `puzzle/plugin/rs/lib.rs` (matching `host.set_active_tool(...)` call sites + two `"activeTool"` JSON literals feeding `WorldInteractionRecord`), `infinite/board/port/directed/rs/lib.rs` (`ActiveTool` enum → `ActiveUtility`) and `infinite/board/port/directed/normal/rs/lib.rs` (field/method/enum-usage rename), `framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx` + `.storybook/stories/puzzle/2d/Board.stories.tsx`/`.storybook/puzzle-2d.spec.ts` (`RasterWasmSession.setActiveTool`→`setActiveUtility`, the story's `case "setActiveTool":` reducer branch — a real dead-code bug since the wire action is `setActiveUtility` — and its `BrushTool`→`BrushUtility` story export/id, kept the spec file's story-id reference in sync).
- `lowpoly/plugin/rs/lib.rs` had ~100 unrenamed hits: `paint_tool`→`paint_utility`, `tool_params`→`utility_params`, `tool_param_f32/u32/f64`→`utility_param_*`, `inspector_tool_param_field`→`inspector_utility_param_field`, `LOWPOLY_TRANSFORM_TOOL_DEFAULT`→`LOWPOLY_TRANSFORM_UTILITY_DEFAULT`, `setToolParam` wire action→`setUtilityParam`, region marker, ~15 test/fn names and doc comments.
- `framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs` (the native desktop shell) had ~130 unrenamed hits across `active_tool_for_window`→`active_utility_for_window`, `tool_cursor_override`→`utility_cursor_override`, `tool_collection_expanded`→`utility_collection_expanded` (+ its `"framework.tool.collection."` id prefix and `"framework.tool.button"`/`"framework.tool.toggle"` control ids), `footer_tool_label`/`render_footer_tool_nodes`→`footer_utility_label`/`render_footer_utility_nodes`, `render_window_tool_options_rail`→`render_window_utility_options_rail` (+ its literal `"Tool Options"` rail title text→`"Utility Options"`), region markers `WindowActionsAndToolsTests`→`WindowActionsAndUtilitiesTests`, `ActionPanelAndTools`→`ActionPanelAndUtilities`, `tool-derivation`→`utility-derivation`, `active-tool`→`active-utility`, and a full test-suite rename (`actions_tools_app`→`actions_utilities_app`, `tool.a`/`tool.b` fixture ids→`utility.a`/`utility.b`, etc).
- `framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs`: builder fns (`.utility()`, `mode_utilities`, `window_kind_utilities`), validation loops/messages, the `ToolPreviewContract` doc region → `UtilityPreviewContract`, and ~15 test names.
- `framework/core/rs/lib.rs`: `UtilityDefinition`/`UtilityRef` doc comments, `#region 🔖️Tools`→`Utilities`, `#region ActionArgsAndToolsTests`→`ActionArgsAndUtilitiesTests`, test names.
- `framework/core/js/index.ts`: `GeneratedToolDefinition`→`GeneratedUtilityDefinition` import alias, `deriveUtilityNodes`'s `tool` locals→`utility`, region markers, remaining doc-comment prose.
- `framework/renderer/wgpu/js/boot.ts`: the plugin-worker RPC surface (`tools`/`PluginModuleHandle.tools`/message-type union) renamed to `utilities` for consistency, even though it appears to be dead code post-migration (flagged below).
- `.storybook/stories/ui/Toolbar.stories.tsx`: `DemoToolLeaf`/`DemoToolNode` → `DemoUtilityLeaf`/`DemoUtilityNode` (the window-scoped-category demo tree).
- Small doc-comment fixes: `draw/rs/lib.rs` (`DRAW_TOOL_IDS`→`DRAW_UTILITY_IDS`, a dead/unused but public constant listing the draw plugin's utility ids), `lowpoly/core/rs/lib.rs`, `remodel/rs/lib.rs`.
- `shooting/plugin/rs/lib.rs`: `#region 🔖️Tools`→`Utilities` region marker.
- draw/process/cad/procedural/remodel/raster/note plugins: full sweep (builder/test/doc renames), each verified individually.

## Task 2: Dropped the redundant "Window" prefix
- `os-shell.tsx`: region `WindowUtilityRegistry`→`UtilityRegistry`, `resolveWindowUtilities`→`resolveUtilities`, `resolveWindowUtilityNodes`→`resolveUtilityNodes`, `windowUtilityBarNode`→`utilityBarNode`, `WINDOW_UTILITY_CATEGORIES`→`UTILITY_CATEGORIES`, `toolOptions`→`utilityOptions` everywhere (the `WindowMeasuresChrome`/`spawnedWindowChromeForKind` prop, the `AppProps.toolOptions` slot in `ui/js/react/index.tsx`, `partitionWindowMeasures`'s return shape in `framework/core/js/index.ts` and its Rust twin `partition_window_measures` in `ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs`).
- Left `tagSetActiveUtilityWindow`, `activeUtilityByWindowId` alone per the ticket's explicit guidance (the "Window" there names a real windowId parameter/map key, not a redundant decorator).
- Left `transformTool`/`transform_tool` alone everywhere it appears (cad/lowpoly/procedural/puzzle/shooting/world-3d/infinite-world) — verified case-by-case that it is a genuinely separate concept (the transform-gumball gizmo mode), distinct from `active_utility_id`/`SetActiveUtility`, and not part of this ticket's object model.
- Left `ToolCategory::Tools`-style category *values*, `"Tools"`/`"Werkzeuge"` translated category labels, and the generic `Toolbar*`/`toolbar` UI-chrome family (`ToolbarZone`/`ToolbarGroup`/`ToolbarItem`/`ToolbarDivider`, `WindowToolbarChrome`, `windowToolbarOverlayClass`, `buildToolbarRibbonSegments`, storybook Toolbar/Window/Navbar/Footer/Tooltip stories) untouched — these are a legitimately distinct, still-current UI concept/label, not the renamed domain model.

## Deliberately left as-is (confirmed unrelated)
- `process/plugin/rs/lib.rs` / `process/3d/rs/lib.rs`: `ProcessMeasure::Cut { tool }`/`SolidSpec`/`toolWidth` etc — a physical CNC cutting-tool concept, unrelated.
- `kernel/3d/brep/**`, `flow/module/brep/rs/lib.rs`, `compose/client/lib/rs/lib.rs`: BRep boolean "tool solid" geometry — unrelated CAD-kernel domain.
- `raster/rs/lib.rs:144` (`DocumentJson.active_tool`) and `raster/plugin/rs/lib.rs:569` (`map.remove("activeTool")`): dead/vestigial premigration document-JSON cleanup that never matches any live field — reviewed, harmless, out of scope.
- `coda/client/**`: Coda's own MCP tool-calling API (`window.coda.tool(...)`) — explicitly out of scope.
- `repo/lib/js/index.ts`, `repo/client/vscode/js/**`, `script.ts`, generic "dev tooling"/"tooling" prose repo-wide — unrelated developer-tooling references.
- `compose/client/lib/sketchpad/js/index.ts`: a separate technology's own i18n bundle (`./compose`) with its own `"Tools"`/`"toolbar"` translation keys — CLAUDE.md forbids mixing technologies, left untouched.
- `cad/renderer/js/index.tsx:6109` ("... tool{s}"): unrelated CAD "interactions" catalogue count text.
- `asset/js/index.ts` (`SelectToolIcon`, `ToolsIcon`): unused icon exports whose naming matches the still-current "Tools" category label, not the renamed model.
- `.storybook/**` generic Toolbar/Tooltip/Window/Navbar/Footer stories, and arbitrary fixture ids/labels in tests (e.g. `"puzzle3d.tool.fill"` in an unrelated Engagement-component test, `"tool-a"`/`"Action tools"` in Panel/Engagement stories) — placeholder data, not the domain model.
- User-facing translated copy ("Tool Params"/"Werkzeugparameter" in `lowpoly/plugin/rs/lib.rs`, the "Tool" readonly-field label) — left as product copy, only the backing field/identifier names were renamed, consistent with "Tools" staying the visible category name throughout the app.

## Found but explicitly NOT fixed (pre-existing, unrelated to this rename — flagging for a separate ticket)
- `writer/plugin/rs/lib.rs`, `sequence/plugin/rs/lib.rs`, `trinity/plugin/rs/lib.rs`: test suites call `app.tools(&ViewState::default())`, but no `tools()` method exists anywhere on `DocumentApp`/`PluginApp`/`VcsDocumentApp` in `framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs` (confirmed via full-repo grep). `cargo check --tests` fails with `E0599: no method named 'tools' found`. Confirmed via `git diff` that these three files had zero changes before this ticket touched them — this is pre-existing breakage from the "list-tools surface is gone" architecture change, whose test call sites were never updated. Renaming the call wouldn't fix it (neither `tools()` nor `utilities()` exist). Left the call sites as-is; a real redesign fix is out of scope for a naming ticket.
- `draw-plugin`, `shooting-plugin`, `puzzle-plugin` (and now also `sequence-plugin`/`trinity-plugin` after this ticket's edits) currently fail `cargo check --tests` with `E0063: missing field 'loading'` on `UiTreeItemNode`/`UiTreeSectionNode`/`UiSectionNode`/`UiTreeNode`, and `missing fields 'action_labels' and 'utility_labels'` on `AppLabelsOverlay` — both are in-flight concurrent changes by another session (confirmed via `git diff` showing tiny unrelated 2-4 line additions landing mid-session across many unrelated plugin crates: flow, forms, imperative, layout, s, vcs, infinite-board-dag). Not caused by this rename; none of the touched lines are struct literals I edited.

## Verification
- `bun x nx run @semio-tech/framework-renderer-react:test`: 160/160 pass.
- `bun x nx run @semio-tech/framework-os-core:test`: 26/26 pass.
- `bun x nx run @semio-tech/ui-react:test`: 257/271 pass; the 14 failures are pre-existing jsdom `PointerEvent`/`Node.contains` API-compatibility issues in unrelated components (`CanvasPickMenu`, `Mode` engagement, `ShellDisplayPanel`, tree helpers) — none reference `tool`/`utility` naming.
- `cargo check --tests` clean (only pre-existing dead-code warnings) for: `ui_wgpu`, `semio-framework-renderer-wgpu`, `semio-framework-core`, `semio-framework-plugin`, `semio-framework-plugin-host`, `infinite_world`, `infinite_board_port_directed`, `infinite_board_port_directed_normal`, `puzzle_2d`, `kernel_3d_brepkit`, `flow_module_brep`, `s-plugin`, `raster` (rs), `process-plugin`, `cad-plugin`, `procedural-plugin`, `remodel-plugin`, `raster-plugin`, `note-plugin`.
- `cargo check --tests` fails for `draw-plugin`, `shooting-plugin`, `puzzle-plugin`, `writer-plugin`, `sequence-plugin`, `trinity-plugin` — all due to the unrelated concurrent issues documented above, not this rename (confirmed by reading every reported error: all are `loading`/`action_labels`/`utility_labels` struct-literal mismatches or the pre-existing missing `tools()` method).
- Final `grep -rci tool` sweep across the repo (excluding `.repo/🎫️/**` and gitignored generated bindings) manually eyeballed; every remaining hit is one of: `Tool*`/`toolbar` generic UI-chrome family, `UtilityCategory::Tools`/`"Tools"` category label, `transformTool` gizmo concept, CNC/BRep "tool solid" geometry, dev-tooling prose, Coda's unrelated MCP tool API, or arbitrary test-fixture placeholder strings.
